module.source: Sunova SS-550-72MDH mono PERC datasheet (Pmax temp. coeff. -0.35 %/degC, NOCT 45+/-2 degC, 2279 x 1134 x 35 mm), https://download.axilogi.com/Sunova/SS-535-550-72MDH.pdf, accessed 2026-11-01

layout.source: Row spacing on flat roofs is CALCULATED per house and panel orientation: gap = raised-edge height / tan(sun elevation at noon on the December solstice), with elevation = 90 - latitude - 23.44 (about 38 deg in Delhi). At 20 deg tilt that is about 1.0 m for portrait panels and 0.5 m for landscape. row_gap_m is the MINIMUM gap (DESIGN CHOICE: room to reach panels for cleaning). DESIGN CHOICES (Aroha, to review with an installer): edge_setback 0.6 m walkway along the parapet, 0.3 m clear around tanks/stair rooms, 0.02 m clamp gap for flush-mounted rows on sloped roofs, 20 deg default tilt on flat roofs (below latitude to keep row spacing and wind load down), facing south.

capacity.source: small_area_m2: about 10 sq m of shadow-free roof per kW (MSEDCL rooftop solar FAQ, https://www.mahadiscom.in/ismart/media/faq.pdf; MNRE/PIB rooftop FAQ gives 10-12 sq m per kWp). DESIGN CHOICES (Aroha): drop 25% of panels from the minimum when a side has heavy shade; warn when no-go areas cover more than 30% of the outline.

losses.source: l_other: NREL PVWatts v5 default losses (Dobos 2014, NREL/TP-6A20-62641; same defaults in pvlib pvwatts_losses) without shading: soiling 2%, mismatch 2%, wiring 2%, connections 0.5%, LID 1.5%, nameplate 1%, availability 3% (combined 11.4%), times 96% nominal inverter efficiency (PVWatts default) = 15.0%. Temperature excluded (handled by gamma). Shading per side (partial 5%, heavy 15%, total capped at 30%): DESIGN CHOICE (Aroha heuristic from 2-3 homeowner questions, not a shade simulation); confidence is lowered whenever shade is reported.

costs.source: MNRE benchmark cost for residential rooftop solar under PM Surya Ghar: INR 50,000 per kW for the first 2 kW (INR 45,000 for additional kW), effective 13 Feb 2024, as reported by Indian Infrastructure / pv magazine India. A benchmark, so real installer quotes are often higher. TO VERIFY on pmsuryaghar.gov.in.

tariff.source: Slabs and fixed charge: DERC Tariff Schedule FY 2019-20 for BRPL/BYPL/TPDDL/NDMC, domestic individual connections (energy 3.00/4.50/6.50/7.00/8.00 Rs per kWh; fixed 20 Rs/kW/month up to 2 kW, not used in savings), https://www.derc.gov.in/sites/default/files/TARIFF%20SCHEDULE%20FY%202019-20.pdf - latest official schedule found; excludes PPAC/FPPAS surcharges and the Delhi free-units subsidy. export_rate_inr: UNVERIFIED - secondary sources put the year-end net-metering settlement (APPC) at about Rs 3-4.30 per unit; the low end is used. Confirm both against the current DERC tariff order and net-metering regulations.

forecast.source: rain_min_mm: IMD 'rainy day' definition (24-hour rainfall of 2.5 mm or more). Ratios (day plane-of-array sunlight vs a typical day of that month from the 10-year climatology): Aroha design choice, display labels only, never used in estimates.
